definitions.explanation: A general term for noodles of all kinds, including ramen, udon, soba, and pasta.

examples.japanese: {麺|めん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のびてしまった。

examples.english: At this shop, you can choose the firmness of the noodles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{麺|めん}{好|ず}きで、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{麺類|めんるい}→麺類：14877_menrui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: He's a huge noodle lover and eats noodle dishes almost every day.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{麺類|めんるい}→麺類：14877_menrui⟧ (noodle dishes, noodles in general)
- {生麺|なまめん} (fresh noodles)
- {乾麺|かんめん} (dried noodles)
- {製麺|せいめん} (noodle making)
- {麺|めん}つゆ (noodle dipping sauce)
- {素麺|そうめん} (thin wheat noodles)
- {冷麺|れいめん} (cold noodles)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麺|めん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ゆでる (boil noodles)
- {麺|めん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のびる (noodles get soggy/overcooked)
- {麺|めん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{硬|かた}さ (noodle firmness)

At ramen shops, common firmness options are {硬|かた}め (firm), ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ (normal), and やわらかめ (soft).
